subject.title: Add a slim Docker image mode with configurable APT package installation

question: Should OpenClaw support deployer-configured APT packages for pulled official Docker images, and if so should the supported path be a derived-image prebuild flow rather than a startup-time installer?
rationale: The remaining choice affects official image hardening, package-manager trust, runtime privileges, gateway downtime, and the documented env/CLI contract, so code inspection cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design a derived-image prebuild flow
options.body: Keep the issue open and specify a prebuild command or documented Dockerfile.extend pattern that builds from the official image before gateway restart.

options.title: Allow startup-time installation
options.body: Accept the downtime and root package-manager risk by adding an explicit first-boot or entrypoint installer with caching, logging, failure semantics, and security docs.

options.title: Keep build-time customization only
options.body: Defer or close this direction and continue steering operators to local builds or custom Dockerfiles for extra packages.

recommendation.title: Design a derived-image prebuild flow
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and specify a prebuild command or documented Dockerfile.extend pattern that builds from the official image before gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent Docker apt hardening and docs history and is the best available routing candidate for the env/CLI and security contract decision.
